title: How countries can end the capability overhang
summary: Our latest report reveals stark differences in advanced AI adoption across countries and outlines new initiatives to help nations capture productivity gains from AI.
body: Our latest report reveals stark differences in advanced AI adoption across countries and outlines new initiatives to help nations capture productivity gains from AI.
summaryZh: 最新报告揭示了全球不同国家在先进AI采纳方面的显著差异，并提出了帮助各国跨越“能力悬崖”以充分捕获AI红利的新举措。该讨论有助于理解人工智能在全球范围内的宏观渗透与普及状况。

aiReview.reasonZh: 文章探讨了国家间高级AI采纳率的差异以及如何消除能力悬崖，对宏观经济与AI生产力普及有一定参考价值。
